scope: Web-first commercial-photography system for MORA Clear Witness Cup: one packaging hero, a strict frontal and strict 90-degree final-check pair, one clear-cup anatomy image, and six matched frontal product portraits composed as a collection grid.
revision7_decision: 개별 컵의 종이 라벨, fiber sleeve, collar, adhesive label과 recipe-color print를 모두 제거한다. 실제 음식이 색을 만들고, 검증 대기 중인 투명 식품 접촉 용기가 상태를 드러내며, 외면의 최소 검정 direct print가 사실을 분류한다. flat peelable foil은 밀봉을 맡고, 제작자의 손과 stainless tool은 실제 검사 동작만 수행한다.

truth_model.L0: Approved actual yogurt supplies density, color and recipe trace.
truth_model.L1: A transparent low-wide food-contact vessel candidate reveals the food while performing containment; its structure remains unvalidated.
truth_model.L2: Minimal black exterior direct print fixes identity and facts; direct print is classification, not evidence of craft.
truth_model.L3: A flat full-perimeter peelable foil with one asymmetric tab provides the directional first-open witness; it is completely removed when opened.
truth_model.L4: Paper or board may appear only as an outer multipack or operational record, never attached to an individual cup and never as barrier or refrigeration theater.

global_series_locks.cup: Same low-wide transparent yogurt-cup geometry in every frame: directional diameter-to-height ratio about 1.55:1, light taper, wide opening, continuous molded flange, modest stable foot, no shoulder, neck, pedestal or heavy glass base.
global_series_locks.cup_material: Neutral clear food-contact polymer or validated equivalent, not glass; plausible wall thickness, molded edge, light scuff tolerance and refraction must remain visible. Do not assert a resin, barrier, recycled content or recovery route.
global_series_locks.print: One neutral-black exterior direct-print system only. No white flood, opaque panel, varnish effect, metallic ink, flavor-color ink, paper simulation, border or ruled grid. Fixed consumer artwork and variable bottom/lower-back code remain separate.
global_series_locks.foil: Same low-glare flat foil, continuous seal edge and one asymmetric tab. Sealed frames keep it flat; open frames remove it completely and place it flat on the surface.
global_series_locks.food: Same common yogurt density and production-tolerant fill discipline. SKU identity comes only from approved actual food trace, never colored light, prop tint, printed marker, garnish theater or retouching.
global_series_locks.maker: Same adult female maker model with tied-back dark hair, charcoal cotton shirt and apron in both table frames; she is a production-role depiction, never the founder and never source evidence.
global_series_locks.workspace: Same contemporary refrigerated-food final-check station: cool pale-mineral wall, brushed stainless worktable, calibrated stainless scale, and a generic shallow tapered-cup indexing/registration fixture. No visible proprietary printer mechanism.
global_series_locks.grade: Warm-neutral daylight/room-light balance around 4300-4800 K, neutral whites, truthful black ink, low-to-moderate contrast, no sepia, teal-orange, green cast or recipe-colored ambient light.
global_series_locks.reflection: Use one broad vertical white reflection to describe each clear sidewall plus narrow black flags for edge definition. Partial polarization may control glare but must not erase all reflections or contact shadows.
global_series_locks.refraction: Retain plausible double edges at wall, fill line, rim and base; keep food hue stable through the wall. No crystal-glass caustics, rainbow dispersion, mirror-plastic sheen or invisible container.
global_series_locks.crop_family: Master at native editorial aspect, with clean safe crops for 16:9, 4:5 and 1:1 only where specified. Never crop through the rim, asymmetric tab, front recipe name, spoon trace or hand-to-tool contact that carries the image's proof.
global_series_locks.series_failure: If the transparent structure, text contrast, seal, food stability or optical truth cannot be shown without falsification, stop the image lane and revise the pack or shot; do not hide the failure with paper, frost, colored ink or grading.

front_hierarchy: Exact working recipe name — largest line
exact_text_system.front_geometry: Unframed centered hierarchy on the front arc, occupying the minimum production-legible area. Directional artwork zone is 65-75 degrees of the cup circumference centered at 0 degrees; final arc, distortion compensation and type size come from physical print trials.
exact_text_system.back_geometry: One narrow neutral-black fact column with legal grouping and barcode quiet area, kept away from maximum curvature and grip pressure; no pharmacy table, manifesto or decorative batch field.
exact_text_system.bottom_geometry: Reserved variable lot/date/line zone plus a verified material identifier only when accurate and required. It is separate from fixed front/back artwork.
exact_text_system.generation_text_rule: The image model may render only the large identity strings MORA and the exact working recipe name. Category, quantity, mandatory facts, barcode and variable codes are inserted from approved vector artwork in post or photographed from an approved physical prototype; the model must not invent microcopy, numbers, dates, barcodes or technical data.
exact_text_system.type_character: Contemporary open sans serif, quiet wordmark, clear recipe-first hierarchy and generous spacing; never monospaced, typewriter, Bell Gothic mimic, stencil, condensed apothecary microtype or faux handwriting.
exact_text_system.legibility_gate: Validate print against every approved fill at dry, chilled, condensed, scuffed and gripped states and at frontal plus 30-degree viewing. For Black Sesame, change zone, type size or geometry first; a narrow integrated non-paper information rail is allowed only after direct-print tests fail and the new structure is fully revalidated.

assets.information_goal: Within three seconds, show that MORA is a refrigerated yogurt in a transparent direct-printed cup: actual food is the color field, black text names it, the foil was a removable seal, and no paper belongs to the individual cup.

assets.occupancy_copy_safe: One open Thyme Honey cup occupies about 46-50% of frame width and 62-68% of frame height in the right half. Preserve a continuous low-detail left 42-45% for web headline and CTA; no prop, foil, reflection or ingredient trace enters that zone. Keep 8% safe margin around cup and 10% bottom allowance for responsive crop.
assets.material_light_reflection_refraction: Broad upper-left soft daylight plus white front fill and narrow black right flag; soft contact shadow on pale mineral surface. Transparent polymer rim, flange, wall thickness, fill line and base double edge remain readable. Front black print uses opaque yogurt as its natural backdrop; back print is rotated out or removed from the sightline so it does not ghost through the front. Condensation is absent or limited to a few irregular cold droplets outside the copy zone. Removed foil is low-glare and lies flat.
assets.exact_text_strategy: Render only MORA and THYME HONEY on the front. Reserve but do not synthesize category and net-quantity microcopy; add approved vector text later. No label-shaped backer, flavor color, numbered formula, date, city, customer name or barcode is visible.
assets.series_locks: Uses the same cup, front arc, black density, foil geometry, pale-mineral ground, grade and Thyme Honey food witness as the frontal collection portrait. Open state is exactly: foil fully removed and flat, untouched surface partly retained, one clean spoon cut and one stainless spoon; no propped lid.
assets.human_tool_action: No person. One small stainless spoon has completed a single pull through the yogurt and rests with a physically coherent contact point; no hovering utensil and no simultaneous pour, garnish or peel action.

pair_continuity_protocol.capture_order: Lock maker, cup, fill, print, foil tab, fixture, scale, hand contact and light first. Capture or generate the frontal master, then move only the camera to exact maker-right 90 degrees without advancing the action.
pair_continuity_protocol.identity_controls: Use the accepted frontal frame as the sole continuity reference for the side companion. Do not infer a founder biography or identify the generated maker as a real person.
pair_continuity_protocol.geometry_controls: Record camera height, subject radius, lens, cup baseline, table line, cup center, hand landmarks, foil tab clock position and light position. The side frame must reconstruct the same 3D contacts.
pair_continuity_protocol.release_test: When shown side by side without captions, reviewers must identify the same person, cup, action phase, workspace and batch moment; only the camera axis may differ.

canonical_replacement_map.value: revision 7의 투명 primary vessel은 실제 음식 상태를 드러내는 방향성 후보이며, complete food-contact structure, light·oxygen·aroma·moisture barrier, migration, seal, recipe stability, distribution and shelf-life 검증을 통과하기 전 production-ready 또는 food-safe 주장이 아니다.

개별 컵에는 paper label, fiber sleeve/collar, adhesive sticker 또는 recipe-color ink를 쓰지 않는다. 외면 검정 direct print, foil, variable code와 외부 multipack의 재료·잉크·접착·barrier·recovery·recycling·freshness·tamper·leak·cold claims는 실제 사양과 지역 검증 전 확정하지 않는다.
음식은 색을 만들고, 투명 용기는 상태를 드러내며, 검정 잉크는 사실을 고정한다. flat foil은 최초 개봉을, 실제 spoon trace와 final-check contact는 음식과 과정의 증거를 맡는다. Direct print는 craft가 아니라 분류다.

대표 key visual은 actual food → transparent food-contact vessel → exterior black direct print → completely removed foil의 관계를 한 장에서 읽히게 하고, 직교 mood pair는 이미 인쇄·충전·밀봉된 컵의 print placement, fill level, foil edge와 clarity를 같은 검사 순간의 두 축에서 보여 준다.
한 컵의 가장 큰 색 면은 실제 음식이고, 투명 벽은 그 상태를 숨기지 않으며, 최소 검정 글자는 이름과 사실만 분류한다. Premium tension은 종이 장식이 아니라 정확한 molded geometry, print registration, clean peel edge와 edible trace에서 나온다.
낮고 넓은 투명 direct-printed cup 안의 실제 요거트와, clear wall·black print·molded flange·flat foil·spoon trace가 만드는 서로 다른 물리적 경계

여섯 제품은 같은 투명 컵, 정면 direct-print origin, open state, 카메라·광원·occupancy·baseline을 고정한 별도 1:1 portrait로 만든 뒤 UI에서 3x2 grid로 조립한다. MORA와 exact recipe name, 승인된 actual food trace만 바뀌며 flavor-color ink, prop color와 배경색은 바뀌지 않는다.
